title: Sprite Animator
description: Plays frame-by-frame spritesheet animations on an entity. Use Sprite Animator to create idle, walk, jump, and attack clips in the Animator Editor.

blocks.content: The **Sprite Animator** component drives frame-by-frame 2D animations by updating an entity's [Image Renderer](components/renderers/sprite_renderer) over time. It opens the dedicated **Animator Editor** workspace where you organize clips into categories, slice source frames, set frame rates, and preview animations with onion skinning.

items.title: Clip Library
items.desc: Organize animations such as **idle**, **run**, and **attack** into named clips and folders.

items.title: Auto Fill Timeline
items.desc: Slice a horizontal or grid spritesheet into timeline frames automatically with **Auto Fill**.

items.title: Per-Clip Pivot & FPS
items.desc: Configure custom frame rate, looping, base size, and 3x3 pivot for every clip.

items.title: Onion Skinning
items.desc: Enable **Show Shadow (Onion Skin)** in the editor to align frames smoothly.

items: Select an entity that already has an [Image Renderer](components/renderers/sprite_renderer) component.
In the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), click **Add Component...** under **Actions** and select **Sprite Animator**.
In the **Sprite Animator** section, click **Open Editor** next to **Clips Data** to open the **Animator Editor** tab.

blocks.message: If the entity does not have an **Image Renderer**, **Sprite Animator** is disabled in **Add Component...** with the label **(Requires SpriteRenderer)**.

blocks.content: Control animation playback and active clips in the **Sprite Animator** section of the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector).

rows: Toggles whether **Sprite Animator** controls the entity's **Image Renderer**. Set to **Disabled** to edit the sprite manually.
Toggles **Playing** or **Paused** to preview the active clip directly in the [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).
Steps through individual frames when **Playback** is paused.
Selects the default animation clip (**ID**) that plays when the scene starts.
Shows the total number of clips and the **Open Editor** button.

blocks.content: Inside the **Animator Editor** tab, select a clip in the left **Clip** panel to configure its **Clip Properties** on the right and its frames in the bottom **Timeline**.

rows: Unique clip identifier used to play this clip from visual scripts.
Spritesheet image asset used by this clip.
Sampling filter (**Pixelated** or **Smooth**) and **SDF** toggle for this clip.
Frame cell width and height in pixels, plus the 3x3 origin pivot for the clip.
Playback speed in frames per second (1 to 60).
**True (Loop)** repeats the clip continuously; **False (Once)** stops on the last frame.
Bottom **Timeline** buttons to append a single frame, slice the spritesheet automatically by **Base Size**, or clear all frames.

blocks.content: Create a looping walk animation from a horizontal spritesheet strip using **Auto Fill**.

items: In the **Sprite Animator** section of the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), click **Open Editor**.
In the left **Clip** panel, right-click empty space and select **New Clip**.
In the right **Clip Properties** panel, set **ID** to **walk**.
Click the **Texture** button (or right-click your spritesheet in the **Assets** dock and choose **Apply to Selected Clip**).
Set **Base Size** (**W** and **H**) to the pixel size of a single frame (such as **32** by **32**).
In the bottom **Timeline** panel, click **Auto Fill**. The editor slices the spritesheet into frames automatically.
Set **Frame Rate (FPS)** to **12**, keep **Loop Animation** set to **True (Loop)**, and click the **Play** button in the timeline to preview.

blocks.content: Use the nodes in [Animation](node_library/game_animation) and [Helper & Tool](node_library/helper_tool) to switch clips and trigger frame events at runtime.

rows: Plays a clip by its **ID** and fires **onComplete** when a non-looping clip finishes.
Pauses the currently playing animation clip.
Reads the active clip **ID**, playing state, or flip state.
Updates the current clip, enabled state, or flip state.
Triggers execution when a clip enters, stays in, or exits a specific frame range (useful for footsteps or sword swings).
Automatically switches between idle, run, jump, and fall clips for a platformer character.
Automatically switches directional idle and walk clips for a top-down character.
**Auto Fill** generates the wrong number or size of frames
Set **Base Size** (**W** and **H**) in **Clip Properties** to match the exact pixel width and height of one frame before clicking **Auto Fill**.
**Sprite Animator** locks **Image Renderer** while active. Click **Enabled** next to **Status** in **Sprite Animator** to switch it to **Disabled** while making manual adjustments.
Character shifts position when switching between clips
Make sure all clips on the entity use a consistent **Pivot** point in **Clip Properties** (for example, bottom-center for ground characters).
